pictures.author: Michael Gunther
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 ordinary west-front picture inspected. Broad dark rubble/coursed sloping truncated pyramid, pale central steep stair slot with taller flanking strips, broad flat summit/pale upper moulded band, low northern stela platform, small southern relief shrine/platform, flat stone turtles and upright stones in the open paved court.

pictures.author: Anton Leddin
pictures.observations: Entire960x640 west-front picture inspected. Narrow dark central stair channel between sloped dressed stone cheeks, short lintel at the upper front, uninterrupted plain sloping pyramid faces, stepped upper crest, low relief platforms/stelae and flattened turtle-like forms. Fine relief inventory, hidden rear and exact dimensions unresolved.

pictures.author: Michael Gunther
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 rear gateway picture inspected to fill gateway coverage gap. Tapering stone piers, real narrow rectangular passage, lintel and original simplified Kala face position, stepped low triangular crest and local paving. Modern metal security gate is host operational state, not authored historic stone fabric.

pictures.author: Hiyotchi
pictures.observations: Entire960x640 ordinary published precinct sketch inspected for relative arrangement only: western gate, three open terraces, main eastern pyramid, north platform/stela range, small Bhimaswarga shrine and south platform. Horizontal dimensions and positions use standard map controls; no image pixels copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Sukuh core: broad flat-topped sloping stone pyramid with true narrow west stair channel and dressed cheeks/upper lintel, moulded summit band, low north/south platforms, small Bhimaswarga relief shrine, original simplified stela/Garuda/turtle vocabulary, western tapered stone gateway with real passage and Kala-like lintel relief, and short terrain-following terrace retaining edges/approaches. Preserve open native-ground courts and independent modern buildings. No roofed summit restoration, copied narrative/text relief or complete interiors.
